answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1964 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the anchor. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the dune queue while honest agents promoted earlier still earns. The forge index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 460 account operation therefore ties up 38 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
